svg.text: Three mutations needed: who is ready at each age?
10,000 cells, 1 in 1,000 chance of a mutation per cell per year. Orange = has 1 mutation. Red = has 2 mutations, so it is ready: one step from cancer.
(red drawn large; they are really 2 cells out of 10,000)
(red drawn large; they are really 8 cells out of 10,000)
(red drawn large; they are really 29 cells out of 10,000)
